subject: deviation investigation procedure
statement: Applies to all personnel involved in deviation investigation procedure operations at Moderna, Inc. facilities including manufacturing operators, QC analysts, and QA personnel
supporting_quote: This SOP applies to all personnel involved in deviation investigation procedure operations at Moderna, Inc. facilities. This includes manufacturing operators, QC analysts, and QA personnel responsible for oversight.

subject: deviation investigation procedure
statement: Deviation investigation procedure execution requires verification of equipment calibration, environmental monitoring, batch record review, procedure performance, real-time parameter recording, in-process sampling, immediate deviation reporting, and equipment sanitization.
supporting_quote: 5.1 Verify all equipment calibration certificates are current and within acceptable limits. 5.2 Complete environmental monitoring checks and confirm area is within specification. 5.3 Review and sign Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR) prior to commencing operations. 5.4 Perform deviation investigation procedure according to the approved batch record instructions. 5.5 Record all process parameters, observations, and measurements in the BMR in real time. 5.6 Collect in-process samples at defined intervals and submit to QC for testing. 5.7 Any deviation from this procedure must be immediately reported to the supervisor and documented per SOP QA-DEV-9835-98. 5.8 Upon completion, clean and sanitize all equipment and workspace per SOP QA-CLN-4295-49.
steps: Verify all equipment calibration certificates are current and within acceptable limits
Complete environmental monitoring checks and confirm area is within specification
Review and sign Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR) prior to commencing operations
Perform deviation investigation procedure according to the approved batch record instructions
Record all process parameters, observations, and measurements in the BMR in real time
Collect in-process samples at defined intervals and submit to QC for testing
Any deviation from this procedure must be immediately reported to the supervisor and documented per SOP QA-DEV-9835-98
Upon completion, clean and sanitize all equipment and workspace per SOP QA-CLN-4295-49

subject: acceptance criteria
statement: All in-process and final product specifications must be met as defined in approved Drug Product specification document SPEC-7537-95; out-of-specification results must be investigated per SOP QA-OOS-7118-66
supporting_quote: All in-process and final product specifications must be met as defined in the approved Drug Product specification document SPEC-7537-95. Out-of-specification (OOS) results must be investigated per SOP QA-OOS-7118-66.
